changelog:
Initial release with core data quality checks planning features.

- Designs data quality checks across standard dimensions: completeness, validity, uniqueness, freshness, consistency, and accuracy.
- Specifies the rule, severity (block vs. warn), and implementation location (dbt, Great Expectations, SQL assertion) for each check.
- Guides on collecting required inputs: table structure, important columns, freshness expectations, and tooling.
- Includes best practices and anti-patterns to ensure actionable, reliable data quality enforcement.
- Output format provides a clear, organized checks plan with explicit failure handling recommendations.
